Verify Now Blog > PCBWay Plug-In for OpenSCAD PCBWay Plug-In for OpenSCAD by: PCBWay Oct 24,2024 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in News We are excited to announce that we have welcomed a new partner! PCBWay has recently collaborated with OpenSCAD to integrate the PCBWay plug-in into the software. This means that from now on, users can directly jump to the PCBWay page from OpenSCAD to place orders, which will greatly improve the efficiency of pre-production preparation work. OpenSCAD download link ( https://openscad.org/ ) After completing the design in OpenSCAD, click Design -> 3D print. In the newly popped-up dialog box, select PCBWay, and then click OK. Then it will be automatically redirected to PCBWay's 3D printing pricing page. After selecting the parameters, you can submit your order. That's how the PCBWay plug-in in OpenSCAD is used.
